flow.name: send-bulk-retention-email-flow
flow.doc:name: Send Bulk Retention Email Flow
flow.doc:description: MCP tool flow that uses Gemini LLM to generate a personalized retention email template and sends individual emails to each customer via AWS SES

mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.name: send-bulk-retention-email
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: MCP tool entry point accepting a list of customers and a campaign object to trigger bulk personalized email sending
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description:
Sends personalized retention emails to a list of customers using the selected Salesforce Campaign.
IMPORTANT TOOL USAGE RULE:
This tool must only be called AFTER the user has selected a campaign.
Before calling this tool, the agent must call the get-campaign-details tool to retrieve the currently active campaigns.
If multiple campaigns are returned: - Present the campaigns to the user. - Ask the user to select one. - Wait for the user's response. - Use the campaign selected by the user.
If exactly one campaign is returned: - The agent may automatically select that campaign.
The selected campaign must come directly from the get-campaign-details tool.
Do not invent campaign IDs, campaign names, descriptions, or campaign details.
The campaign object passed to this tool must contain: - Id - Name - IsActive - Description
After the campaign has been selected, this tool generates a personalized retention email using Gemini and sends the email to each customer's Email__c address.

logger.doc:name: Log - Request Received
logger.doc:description: Logs the tool invocation with customer count and campaign name
logger.message: #["[send-bulk-retention-email-flow] Tool invoked - customers: " ++ (sizeOf(payload.customers as Array) as String default "0") ++ ", campaign: " ++ ((payload.campaign.Name as String) default "null")]

set-variable.doc:name: Save Input Payload
set-variable.doc:description: Preserves the original MCP tool input (customers array and campaign object) before payload is overwritten by the Gemini HTTP call

ee:transform.doc:name: Build Gemini Prompt
ee:transform.doc:description: Constructs the Gemini API request body with a prompt asking the LLM to generate a retention email template using named placeholders

http:request.doc:name: Call Gemini LLM API
http:request.doc:description: Sends the retention email prompt to Google Gemini 2.0 Flash and receives the AI-generated email template

set-variable.doc:name: Extract Email Template
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts the AI-generated email template text from the Gemini API response

logger.doc:name: Log - Template Generated
logger.doc:description: Confirms Gemini LLM successfully generated the email template before customer iteration begins

foreach.doc:name: For Each Customer
foreach.doc:description: Iterates over each customer to personalize the Gemini template and dispatch individual retention emails

ee:transform.doc:name: Personalize Email Body
ee:transform.doc:description: Replaces named placeholders in the Gemini template with real customer field values to produce a personalized email body

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output text/plain var customerName = payload.Name default ((payload.FirstName default "") ++ " " ++ (payload.LastName default "")) //var riskLevel = payload.Churn_Risk_Level__c default "N/A" var validTill = payload.Valid_Till__c as String default "N/A" var churnScore = payload.Churn_Score__c as String default "N/A" var campaignName = vars.inputPayload.campaign.Name default "Campaign" --- vars.emailTemplate replace "{{CUSTOMER_NAME}}" with customerName // replace "{{RISK_LEVEL}}" with riskLevel replace "{{VALID_TILL}}" with validTill replace "{{CHURN_SCORE}}" with churnScore replace "{{CAMPAIGN_NAME}}" with campaignName

logger.doc:name: Log - Sending Email
logger.doc:description: Logs the customer name and email address before sending the personalized retention email

ee:transform.doc:name: Set Success Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Sets the MCP tool response as a summary string indicating how many emails were sent and for which campaign

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- "Emails sent to " ++ (sizeOf(vars.inputPayload.customers) as String) ++ " customers for campaign: " ++ (vars.inputPayload.campaign.Name default "Campaign")

on-error-propagate.doc:name: On Error Propagate
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Catches any error during Gemini API call or email sending and propagates it with an error log

logger.doc:name: Log - Error
logger.doc:description: Logs the full error description when the flow encounters an unexpected failure
